selected_variables: initialized full control schedule; local bounded control corrections at knots 0.42 s, 0.50 s, 0.58 s over correction window 0.18 s

input.expected_observation: Direct MuJoCo Native rollouts from local_control_search_v2 return a best-found corrected schedule with lower best_found_J than the initialized schedule; success would additionally require terminal_error_m and holding_max_error_m at most 0.01 m and holding_max_speed_m_s at most 0.03 m/s.
input.fixed_conditions: Keep candidate structure, MuJoCo model and integration settings, task target [0.295, 0, 0.215] m, 0.6 s duration, 0.02 s control/sample periods, 0.001 s timestep, and the supplied initialized schedule as source fixed; use local_control_search_v2 with correction_window_s 0.18, knots_s [0.42, 0.50, 0.58], at most 24 callbacks and at most 3 iterations. Treat all outcomes as simulation-only and local finite-search evidence.
input.hypothesis: For the fixed legal structure and initialized full control schedule, a bounded three-knot correction over the final 0.18 seconds can reduce the MuJoCo Native reach-and-hold objective relative to that schedule and may satisfy the sealed terminal, holding-error, and holding-speed thresholds within this local finite search.
input.interpretation: This test evaluates bounded local control capability of one fixed structure under direct MuJoCo Native dynamics. Improvement supports only a local correction opportunity; failure weakens this correction hypothesis but does not establish structural or global task infeasibility.
input.stopping_condition: After one admitted Native nonlinear capability result, interpret its exact baseline and best-rollout metrics and choose continuation, design revision, or truthful STOP without claiming global optimality, strict gradients, hardware performance, or infeasibility.
input.weakening_observation: The admitted finite search finds no valid correction improving best_found_J, encounters numerical failure, or its best rollout remains outside one or more frozen reach-and-hold thresholds.
